Classroom Kai Variant — U+7240 牀

Source font: 全字庫正楷體 TW-Kai (CNS11643).
Original copyright and version metadata are recorded in references/kai-variant-font.json.
Official source: https://data.gov.tw/dataset/5961
Download mirror: https://github.com/XiaoPanPanKevinPan/fontCollection

原提供機關：國家發展委員會／數位發展部 CNS11643 全字庫。

Modification: retained only U+7240 and required font metadata; renamed the subset to Classroom Kai Variant. Original glyph outlines are preserved. No other game characters use this supplemental font.
